description: This file contains extension methods for configuring content field display drivers within the OrchardCore CMS framework, including registration, removal, and configuration of display modes and editors.

classes.name: ContentFieldServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring content field display drivers in dependency injection.

methods.name: UseDisplayDriver
methods.description: Registers a display driver for use with a content field and all display modes and editors, overriding previous registrations.

methods.name: UseDisplayDriver (overload)
methods.description: Registers a display driver by type for use with all display modes and editors.

methods.name: UseDisplayDriver (generic with predicate)
methods.description: Registers a display driver with a predicate for filtering display modes and editors.

methods.name: RemoveDisplayDriver
methods.description: Removes a display driver from all editors and display modes.

methods.name: RemoveDisplayDriver (by type)
methods.description: Removes a display driver by type from all editors and display modes.

methods.name: ForDisplayMode
methods.description: Registers a display driver for all display modes.

methods.name: ForDisplayMode (overload)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific display mode.

methods.name: ForDisplayMode (generic with predicate)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific display mode with a predicate filter.

methods.name: ForDisplayMode (by type and predicate)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific display mode with a predicate filter.

methods.name: ForEditor
methods.description: Registers a display driver for all editors.

methods.name: ForEditor (by type)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific editor.

methods.name: ForEditor (generic with predicate)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific editor with a predicate filter.

methods.name: ForEditor (by type and predicate)
methods.description: Registers a display driver for a specific editor with a predicate filter.
